en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a street scene leading up to a fortified gate set in an old city wall. Two- and three-story buildings with steep tiled roofs line the road; people in early 20th‑century clothing walk toward and away from the arched gateway. Leafless trees stand on the right. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the view and location in Croatian and French.
